name: Turkey Taco Rice Bowl with Pico de Gallo & Avocado Slices

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup basmati rice
16 fl oz (2 cups) water

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 pint grape tomatoes
1 avocado
1 lime
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Quarter the grape tomatoes and transfer to a medium salad bowl (that will hold the pico de gallo salsa).
Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Add to the salad bowl.
Juice the lime and add to the salad bowl.
Trim off and discard the ends of the onion and remove the outer layer; small dice the onion into ¼-inch pieces. Transfer one ½ of the diced onion to the salad bowl and the other ½ to a small bowl.
Add coconut oil to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.
In a small bowl, combine and mix together chili powder, cumin, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp chili powder
2 tsp cumin
1 tsp oregano
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add the remaining onion; cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the ground turkey to the skillet; cook, breaking apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 3 to 4 minutes.
Add the spice mixture to the onion and turkey; stir until fragrant and well combined into the mixture, 15 to 30 seconds.
Season the pico de gallo with salt and pepper; toss to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove the pit from the avocado with a knife or spoon; thinly slice the flesh crosswise (without piercing the skin) and scoop out. Transfer to a small bowl.
Uncover the rice and fluff with a fork.
To serve, arrange the rice, ground turkey, pico de gallo, and avocado slices in bowls. Enjoy!
